newsitem.title: NORWAY: Saga plugs poor well in North Sea.
newsitem.headline: Saga plugs poor well in North Sea.

text.p: Saga Petroleum ASA, as operator of licence 008, has plugged a disappointing exploration well in North Sea block 2/6 east of the Ekofisk oilfield, the Oil Directorate said on Wednesday.
Well 2/6-5 was drilled to a depth of 3,237 metres below sea level. It produced only mininmal quantities of oil when production tested due to poor reservoir characteristics, the directorate said.
A spokesman for Saga said the company intended to spud a new well in the area in the third or fourth quarter depending on rig availability.
Partners in licence 088 are Saga and Amerada Hess Norge AS with 50 percent each.
